title: Colony PCR Protocol
author: Zhujun Wei
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bnyemfte

steps.title: Prepare colony PCR template
steps.instruction: Pick colonies to serve as template for colony PCR; the number of colonies taken from each plate should reflect the difference between positive and negative controls, and add water to fill the remaining volume.

substeps.instruction: Pick colonies as template for colony PCR.
Determine number of colonies per plate based on the difference between positive and negative controls.
Add water to fill the rest of the reaction mixture.

steps.title: Test digest and gel analysis
steps.instruction: Perform a test digest on the PCR product and analyze the resulting fragments by agarose gel electrophoresis to confirm the presence of the correct construct.

substeps.instruction: Run the digest products on an agarose gel.
Examine the gel to verify that the correct construct is present.

steps.title: Process positive colonies
steps.instruction: Use colony PCR to increase the number of colonies, then mini‑prep only those clones that test positive.

substeps.instruction: Perform colony PCR to enlarge colony numbers.
